defs.title: Metric definitions
defs.sub: Defined once as SQL views, versioned in git · reports and CRM read the same views

rows.mrr: Sum of active subscriptions per month from the billing mirror (billing.changed), excluding complimentary and trial. Annual plans divided by 12.
rows.net_new_mrr: New and reactivated + expansion − contraction − churn, by comparing each subscription’s MRR with its last snapshot before the month.
rows.trial_conversion: Share of a trial cohort confirmed as paying within 45 days of the trial’s start.
rows.activated: Organizations with at least one group reaching the organization’s own answer threshold (result unlocked).
rows.logo_churn: Paying subscriptions that drop to no MRR, counted in the month it happens.
rows.revenue_churn: MRR lost to churn and contraction per month.
rows.health: Weighted score 0–100 from five signals; the latest score per application, recomputed nightly and when the model changes.
